headline: HuyenBao v11.36 — nhóm menu + pin, gộp tổng quan + nhân vật, edit profile (avatar + tên)
summary: UI REDESIGN + EDIT PROFILE. The PinZone sticky bar now shows the player's emoji avatar + a ✏️ edit button that opens a new Edit Profile modal — pick from 40 emoji avatars (people, animals, fantasy) + rename the character anytime. HomeTab hero card redesigned to stop duplicating PinZone info: it's now a compact identity strip (large avatar + name + job/study/rent) with health/spirit/XP bars, since PinZone already carries the numbers. Nav menus (gnav + subnav) stay horizontal-scroll on ALL screen sizes — no more wrapping that eats vertical space on mobile.
features: EDIT PROFILE: new modal with 40-emoji avatar picker + name field, opened from PinZone ✏️ button
NEW GameState.avatar field (emoji string, default 🧑/👨/👩 by gender) — migrated for old saves
PINZONE: avatar emoji + ✏️ edit button next to character name
HOMETAB REDESIGN: hero card no longer duplicates PinZone — compact identity strip + health/spirit/XP bars only
NAV NO-OVERFLOW: gnav + subnav use horizontal scroll on mobile too (was: wrap to multiple lines = vertical space waste)
ENGINE: begin() accepts optional avatar; migrate() backfills avatar for old saves
